name: sticky-hero-section
blurb: Scroll-stacked sticky sections with parallax scale and rotate on viewport scroll.
description: 200vh container with two sticky viewport-height sections. Section 1 (light) and Section 2 (dark) scale and rotate on scroll. Grid pattern overlays with image gallery. No props, default export.
use_when: Multi-section landing page where each section reveals on scroll with layered parallax.
avoid_when: Heavy motion; no prefers-reduced-motion guard. Images via external URLs.
a11y: Heading text readable. Images have alt text. Motion-heavy; may disorient some users.
